#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string input;
    std::cin >> input;
    
    int count = 0;
    int i = 0;
    int n = input.length();
    
    while (i < n) {
        char currentChar = input[i];
        int j = i;
        int temp = 0;
        
        while (j < n && input[j] == currentChar) {
            j++;
            temp++;
        }
        
        if (temp % 2 == 0) {
            count++;
        }
        
        i = j;
    }
    
    std::cout << count;
    
    return 0;
}
